---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Squirrels
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're experiencing. Focus on the "why," not the "what."

Example: *"When I have 10 items in the sidebar, there's no way to collapse sections — users have to scroll past a long sidebar to reach the main content."*

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like to see.

Be specific: not "better sidebar" but "a collapsible widget panel option in the Customizer."

## Alternatives Considered

Have you found any workarounds or alternative approaches? Why aren't they sufficient?

## Is this for the Free theme or Pro?

Based on the [Free vs Pro feature plan](../../FREE-VS-PRO.md):

- [ ] This belongs in the **free theme** (core functionality, needed for a standard store to work)
- [ ] This belongs in **Squirrels Pro** (advanced conversion tools, design options, or premium features)
- [ ] I'm not sure — please help categorise

## Additional Context

Add mockups, screenshots, links to similar implementations in other themes, or any other context that helps explain the request.

---

**Before submitting:**
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have read [FREE-VS-PRO.md](../../FREE-VS-PRO.md) and believe this is appropriate for the free theme
- [ ] I am not requesting a customisation (e.g., "change the font") — those belong in a child theme or Customizer
